items.html: *And behold, through the aforementioned raising of MAN, which are the aforementioned lights, the aspect of HaVaYaH of AB of Yudin, which is the whole of the aspect of the Mochin of AK, coupled with the aspect of the Taamim of SAG, which are AHP, as above. For these Taamim of SAG had no shattering in them at all, and therefore they coupled together with the aspect of the AB of AK. And the intention is not the lights that emerge from the breath of AHP, but rather the aspect of their very essence and internality itself.
